messages:
maya: FYI onboarding hit a weird HF -> Redwood conversion issue. model requires trust_remote_code / custom config class and the converter dropped auto_map entries + special tokens. quantization run fails and evals show quality regression. :bug:
sam: which model? link?
maya: private repo name is open-source style 'gpt-custom-arch-v2' (can't paste repo). config.json contains \"auto_map\" -> {\"AutoModel\": \"custom_module.CustomModel\"} and also a special_tokens_map, but tokenizer.json on disk doesn't have them. when we run redwood-convert without trust_remote_code, it falls back to standard classes which mismatch.
jordan: ugh. our converter explicitly rejects trust_remote_code in hosted conversion for safety, so we never execute the repo's classes. that means autoload fails and layer names differ -> bnb/4-bit complains at runtime. typical error: \"RuntimeError: module 'CustomSelfAttention' not found in mapping\".
alex: short term workaround: run conversion in a secure sandbox where you can allow trust_remote_code, export the converted artifacts, then import to Redwood. example command I used locally:
```
python scripts/convert_hf_to_redwood.py \
  --hf-dir ./gpt-custom-arch-v2 \
  --out ./redwood_build \
  --trust-remote-code True \
  --inject-special-tokens True
```
that preserves auto_map mapping and writes a patched config.json.
maya: I tried the sandbox route and still hit a mismatch: quant step fails with bitsandbytes complaining about unsupported layer names during int4 packing. log snippet:
```
ERROR: bnb.nn  - Unsupported module name: CustomSelfAttention
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"quantize.py\", line 128, in <module>
    model = quantize_model(model)
  ...
RuntimeError: Module mapping failed for CustomSelfAttention
```
sam: does the model include a config.key called \"architectures\" that references a custom class? auto_map + architectures + trust_remote_code combos are the tricky ones. can we normalize names via a shim config?
maya: yes config.architectures points to \"CustomModel\". I made a tiny patch to config.json to add a shim mapping and appended a minimal special_tokens_map. snippet I used:
```
{
  \"auto_map\": {\"AutoModel\": \"custom_module.CustomModel\"},
  \"architectures\": [\"CustomModel\"],
  \"special_tokens_map\": {\"cls_token\": \"<cls>\", \"sep_token\": \"<sep>\"}
}
```
and then I patched tokenizer.json to include those tokens. that fixed tokenization regressions, but quant still choked on custom layer naming.
jordan: two angles: 1) make the converter detect auto_map/trust_remote_code and surface a manual-review flag (fail fast + instructions). 2) add a safer auto_map handling: instead of executing code, infer interface shape (e.g., look at state_dict keys) and map custom layers to our generic kernel implementations where possible. it's nontrivial but doable for common patterns (attn/qkv, rotary, etc.).
alex: also add a pre-conversion lint that rejects models with unknown module prefixes for bitsandbytes quantization and emits a clear remediation: either vendor shim+safe import or run conversion in a trusted environment. we should also inject tokenizer special tokens into the fallback tokenizer earlier.
maya: eval impact: before conversion we had perplexity ~12.1 on dev eval, after naive conversion it jumped to 38 and Rouge-L dropped ~15 points. with the tokenizer patch only, perplexity went to 18. so tokenization + architecture mapping both matter.
sam: good diagnostics — can you upload a tiny repro (model config + tokenizer.json) and attach to the issue? I'll triage and route to eng-runtime if it's a kernel/quant mapping bug.
maya: will upload sanitized config + tokenizer. i also have a minimal script that reproduces the bnb error — i'll attach.
jordan: I'll open an epic: include tasks: detection lint, converter support for auto_map metadata, tokenizer special_tokens injection, and a short-term doc/flow for \"trusted conversion\" with security checklist. tagging @eng-runtime and @security for design review.
ci-bot: created issue #4521 (hf-convert-auto-map-quirks) and attached CI regression that mirrors the reported eval drop. :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks — prioritize this as P1 for onboarding blocked models. maya, thx for the repro.
maya: thanks all — will post artifacts in the issue and DM the secure link. :lock:
